name: Parfait Sucreal
original_name: パルフェ・シュクレール
source:
A witch apprentice who inherited the "Black Cat Magic Shop" from her deceased mother. She is a third-year high school student at Flor Hermos Magic Academy, but she is taking a leave of absence to concentrate on running the store. Parfait's father was a court mage, but her died when Parfait was just one year old. Despite that, Parfait has a cheerful disposition. She is clumsy and prefers to do things at her own pace. Her catchphrase is "Hamyu".
